title: The Remote Agent Experiment: Debugging Code from 60 Million Miles Away
summary: Ron Garret tells the story of the Remote Agent Experiment on NASA's Deep Space 1, where autonomous software controlled a spacecraft in 1999. He describes debugging Lisp code remotely from millions of miles away.
why: Cited in Lisp and safety-critical software threads as the definitive firsthand account of the DS1 remote REPL debugging episode.

quote.text: Ron Garret talks about DS1, a project in the 90s where a small team used Lisp
